# react-italy-map

> Interactive SVG map of Italy for React (>=17): 20 regions and 110 provinces (ISTAT 2025 boundaries), choropleths, selection, zoom, tooltips, keyboard support. No runtime dependencies, SSR-safe, TypeScript types included.

This file is a guide for AI coding agents integrating the library. The full human docs are in README.md; every prop is also documented with JSDoc in the shipped `.d.ts` files. Only use the props and exports listed here — do not invent others.

## Install and entry points

```bash
npm install react-italy-map
```

- `react-italy-map` → `ItalyMap` (regions), `Legend`, data and helpers.
- `react-italy-map/provinces` → `ItalyProvincesMap`, `ItalyDrilldownMap` (separate entry so province geometry is only bundled when used).

No CSS import is needed: styles are inlined. Components carry `"use client"` and render on the server.

## Pick the component

| Need | Component |
|---|---|
| One value / state per region | `ItalyMap` |
| One value / state per province, whole country or some regions (`region="Lombardia"`) | `ItalyProvincesMap` |
| Regions first, click one to open its provinces in place | `ItalyDrilldownMap` (`data` = regions, `provinceData` = provinces) |
| Colour key for a choropleth | `Legend` with the same `colors` / `domain` / `steps` |

Not supported: municipalities (comuni), custom GeoJSON / other boundaries (ASL, constituencies), lat/lon markers or points. `data[].child` places a React node at an area's centre — the only way to put content on the map.

## Data contract

`data` (and `provinceData`) is an array of entries, or an object keyed by id:

```ts
type AreaData<TMeta> = {
  id: string;            // see "Ids" below
  value?: number;        // must be a finite number; strings are ignored (no colour, no error)
  color?: string;        // explicit fill, wins over colorScale
  hoverColor?: string;
  label?: string;        // label text when showLabels
  child?: ReactNode;     // node at the area's centre
  disabled?: boolean;    // not clickable / selectable / focusable
  className?: string;
  meta?: TMeta;          // your record, returned in callbacks as area.data.meta
};
// or: { Lombardia: { value: 10 }, Lazio: { value: 5 } }
```

The library never fetches, parses or aggregates. Always transform first:

```ts
const toNumber = (s: string) => Number(s.replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.')); // Italian "1.234,5"
const data = rows.map((row) => ({ id: row.regione, value: toNumber(row.totale), meta: row }));
```

Aggregate one-row-per-item data yourself; `findProvince(x)?.regionCode` maps a province to its region:

```ts
import { findProvince } from 'react-italy-map';
const totals: Record<string, number> = {};
for (const t of tickets) {
  const region = findProvince(t.provincia)?.regionCode;
  if (region) totals[region] = (totals[region] ?? 0) + 1;
}
const data = Object.entries(totals).map(([id, value]) => ({ id, value }));
```

## Ids

Matching is case-, accent- and punctuation-insensitive.

- Regions: ISO `IT-25`, ISTAT `03` / `3`, Italian or English name (`Lombardia`, `Lombardy`), bilingual official name.
- Provinces: sigla `MI` / `IT-MI`, ISTAT `015` / `15`, name (`Milano`, `Reggio nell'Emilia`), aliases (`Reggio Emilia`, `Monza e Brianza`, `Bozen`, `Forli-Cesena`…).
- Neighbours (ItalyMap only, clickable like regions): `SM` San Marino, `VA` Vatican City, `FR-H` Corsica. Hide them with `showSanMarino` / `showVatican` / `showCorsica={false}`.

NOT recognised — normalise before passing:

- Prefixes: `Regione X`, `Provincia di X`, `Città metropolitana di X`.
- English city names (`Milan`, `Rome`): use the Italian name or the sigla.
- `P.A. Trento` / `P.A. Bolzano`, region codes `21` / `22` (health / civil-protection datasets): sum into `IT-32` on the region map, or use `TN` / `BZ` on the province map.
- `SU` / `Sud Sardegna` / ISTAT `111`: abolished in 2025, no shape.

Validate: `findRegion(id)` / `findProvince(id)` return `undefined` when nothing matches. `ItalyMap` and `ItalyProvincesMap` warn in development for unmatched ids; `ItalyDrilldownMap` drops them silently.

## Colour

```tsx
const SCALE = { colors: ['#e0f2fe', '#0c4a6e'], domain: [0, 500] as [number, number], steps: 5 };
<Legend {...SCALE} title="Ticket attivi" format={(v) => v.toLocaleString('it-IT')} />
<ItalyMap data={data} colorScale={SCALE} formatValue={(v) => `${v} ticket`} />
```

- `colorScale`: `{ colors: hex[], domain?: [min, max], steps?: number }` (hex colours only) or `(value, area) => cssColor` for thresholds, categories, diverging scales.
- Without `domain` the scale spans the current min–max: set a fixed `domain` for live / changing data and for several maps compared side by side.
- Areas without an entry use `theme.fill`; choose it so "no data" is distinguishable from the lowest colour.
- `Legend` only draws gradients / steps; for categories render your own legend.

## Props (shared by all three maps)

`data`, `colorScale`, `formatValue(value, area)`, `theme`, `className`, `style`, `width`, `height`, `title`,
`selected`, `defaultSelected`, `selectionMode: 'none' | 'single' | 'multiple'`, `onSelectionChange(codes, area)`, `dimUnselected`,
`tooltip` (boolean), `renderTooltip(area)` (or a function as `children`), `showLabels`, `labelText(area)`,
`zoomable`, `maxZoom`, `showZoomControls`, `zoomOnSelect`, `include`, `exclude`, `showCorsica`, `showSanMarino`, `showVatican`.

- `ItalyMap`: `onRegionClick(area, event)`, `onRegionHover(area | null, event | null)`.
- `ItalyProvincesMap`: `region` (one or more region ids; fits the view), `showRegionBorders`, `onProvinceClick`, `onProvinceHover`.
- `ItalyDrilldownMap`: no `selected*` / `selectionMode` / `onSelectionChange` / `dimUnselected` / `zoomOnSelect` / `include` / `exclude`. Instead: `region` / `defaultRegion` / `onRegionChange(area | null)`, `provinceData`, `provinceColorScale`, `dimOthers`, `showBackButton`, `backLabel`, `closeOnBackgroundClick`, `selectedProvinces` / `defaultSelectedProvinces` / `provinceSelectionMode` / `onProvinceSelectionChange(codes, province)`, and the four click / hover callbacks.

`theme` keys: `fill`, `stroke`, `strokeWidth`, `hoverFill`, `selectedFill`, `disabledFill`, `foreignFill`, `dimOpacity`, `focusStroke`, `labelColor`, `labelHalo`, `labelSize`, `regionBorder`. Each is also a CSS variable on `.rim` (`--rim-fill`, …). Areas are `<path class="rim-area" data-code="IT-25">`.

Selection turns on (`'single'`) as soon as `selected`, `defaultSelected` or `onSelectionChange` is passed.

## Callbacks

Callbacks receive a `MapArea`:

```ts
{ code: 'IT-25', name: 'Lombardia', kind: 'region' | 'province' | 'foreign', istat?: '03', regionCode?: 'IT-25', selected, disabled, data?: AreaData }
```

`code` and `onSelectionChange` codes are always canonical (`IT-25`, `MI`), never the id you passed. Use `area.data?.meta` to reach your record. A controlled `selected` accepts any id.

## Imperative handle

```tsx
const ref = useRef<ItalyMapHandle>(null);
<ItalyMap ref={ref} zoomable />;
ref.current?.zoomTo(['Calabria', 'Sicilia'], { padding: 0.15, animate: true });
ref.current?.zoomIn(); ref.current?.zoomOut(); ref.current?.resetZoom();
ref.current?.getSvgElement();
ref.current?.toSVGString(); // standalone SVG markup
```

## Data helpers

`REGIONS`, `PROVINCES`, `PROVINCES_BY_REGION` (keyed by Italian region name), `findRegion(id)`, `findProvince(id)`, `getProvincesOfRegion(id)`, `getRegionsOfArea('nord-ovest' | 'nord-est' | 'centro' | 'sud' | 'isole')`, `createColorScale(options)`, `interpolateColor(a, b, t)`, `normalizeId(id)`.

`RegionInfo`: `{ code, istat, name, nameEn, capital, area }`. `ProvinceInfo`: `{ code, istat, name, officialName?, region, regionCode, type, aliases? }`.
